items.title: Eddie Locke interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, NY, January 13, 2001
items.q: And I used to go down there every week with Jo, whenever Jo played there, and just sit you know. And so he identified me.

ctx.x: He ran a place down on Second Avenue, where the college kids went. Every Friday and Saturday night they had jazz. And Jo Jones used to play there and Roy Eldridge, Charlie Shavers, Willie “The Lion” Smith. And I used to go down there every week with Jo, whenever Jo played there, and just sit you know. And so he identified me.
